definitions.explanation: To cook food quickly in a small amount of oil over high heat while stirring.

examples.japanese: {玉|たま}ねぎを{炒|いた}めてから{肉|にく}を{入|い}れる。
examples.english: Add the meat after sautéing the onions.

notes:
{炒|いた}める means to stir-fry.

DON'T CONFUSE:
- {炒|いた}める: to stir-fry (cooking)
- {傷|いた}める: to damage, hurt

COOKING TERMS:
- {炒|いた}め{物|もの}: stir-fried dish
- {野菜|やさい}{炒|いた}め: stir-fried vegetables
- {焼|や}く: to grill, bake
- {煮|に}る: to boil, simmer
